event_summary: A small green oval item remains on a circular stovetop burner while blue and orange flames flicker around it and visible dark and pale areas on the item change slightly.
raw_event_description: The video starts with a small green-yellow oval item already positioned at the center of a circular burner. Blue flame is visible around the lower part of the item, with taller orange flame tongues on both sides. Through the clip the flames repeatedly change shape and height, especially on the right side. The item stays near the same central position, with dark patches and pale torn-looking areas visible along its side and lower edge; a red-orange exposed area behind or beside it becomes more apparent during the sequence. The burner ring and surrounding stovetop remain stationary.

reasons: The small green item, burner, and flames are already visible in the first frame.
The visible process is already underway at the start.
The camera view shows the burner and surrounding stovetop clearly.
